findings.summary: get_user builds SQL by string concatenation of user_id; switch to parameterized queries so request input cannot alter the statement.
get_user_profile takes requester_id but never enforces ownership; any requester can fetch any user_id (IDOR).

notes: Opened security-hardening-checklist.md; ran S1–S11. Injection and broken access control only. Fixture comment labels IDOR as S2; checklist maps IDOR to S5.
